Discovering this 3D printing shop hidden away on the dainty  uphill streets of Pali Village in Bandra was an absolute delight! I stumbled upon this cozy shop while on the hunt for something unique to add to my wardrobe, and I couldn't have been more thrilled.

From the moment I walked in, the quiet unassuming streets of Pali Village teleported me into a different dimension altogether  where the walls were adorned with innovative designs and sharply crafted  3D printed models with discernible features even  at that tiny scale. .

The hoodie itself was a masterpiece – soft, comfortable, and beautifully printed. The ISRO logo and design were flawlessly captured, a true tribute to India's space agency. It felt like wearing a piece of history, a symbol of inspiration and achievement.

The shop's staff were very sweet about it. They shared insights into the printing process, patiently answered my questions, and made me feel like a valued customer.

As I left the shop with my ISRO hoodie in hand, It wasn't just a hoodie; it was a connection to innovation, exploration, and the indomitable spirit of human endeavor which is what ISRO stands for.

In a bustling city like Mumbai, finding a shop that offers not just products, but experiences is a rarity. If you're in search of unique treasures that tell a story and capture the essence of your passions, look no further. This hidden gem is a true haven for those who appreciate creativity, quality, and a touch of magic in their shopping endeavors.

featured_reviews.review_text: Amazing experience! Hinesh and Jitu were extremely knowledgeable and accommodating. It felt like a time machine going through the various eras of Bollywood. If you are a cinephile or a fan of unique art pieces, I absolutely recommend checking Indian Hippy out!

featured_reviews.name: Aditya Ravi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Stopped by on two different occasions to browse the vintage Hollywood posters and ads they have in store.

Thw owner, Hinesh,  and his team was incredibly patient, especially since I had told them upfront that I wasn’t sure what I wanted and was just looking around.

Their collection is fantastic; original Hollywood posters ranging from films of the 1930s to more modern classics. Prices vary widely too, from around ₹500 to a few thousands.

I ended up picking up a vintage Alfred Hitchcock poster and a Charlie Chaplin poster, both of which I’m excited to frame and put up at home.

The staff was never pushy, just helpful, making the whole experience genuinely enjoyable.

I’d highly recommend this store if you’re looking to own original vintage movie posters and memorabilia.

featured_reviews.name: Inan Chowdhury
featured_reviews.review_text: Such an amazing collection, we felt like we were in a museum. The shop owner was super helpful and knowledgeable about each piece. We ended up buying 3-4 posters but enjoyed looking at each individually. All different sizes available as well

featured_reviews.review_text:
I found this place through a Google search as I was planning to visit the Mumbai Bollywood poster museum. Instead of going to the museum I decided to go to Indian Hippy (on the hill to the left) and was absolutely thrilled.

Such a brilliant collection of posters, great hospitality and so much knowledge. I left very happy having bought quite a few posters and having seen so many more and learned so much.

I could have spent hours here quite easily.

If you're into posters, graphic design, illustration, Bollywood, or design more generally, then I think this might be the place for you. A wonderful shop and a wonderful experience.

And: posters very well packed in heavy duty tubes.

featured_reviews.name: Varun Gajjar
featured_reviews.review_text:
This was my first time buying a vintage poster for a friend, and honestly, it turned into so much more than just a purchase. We ended up having a great conversation about the history of Bollywood and how these posters were actually made back in the day.

Apart from buying the poster, I walked away with a deeper appreciation for the legacy of Indian cinema it felt like a full experience rather than a transaction. I’d 100% recommend this to filmmakers, film geeks, or anyone who loves cinema.

100/100 for the experience and entertainment, and 1000/1000 for the buying experience. 🎬

featured_reviews.name: Hemang
featured_reviews.review_text:
This store is epic! Make sure to come by here if you have any interest in Bollywood films and vintage movie posters.

It’s a nondescript store behind a clothing shop, so make sure to peek through the driveway for the fun logo of the man with a mustache. I shared a photo of the outside.

The owner, Hiresh, is super informative and friendly and PATIENT. We spent over 1.5 hours here going through all the posters he has to sell. People who are passion about their business really inspire us and we’re so happy we purposefully came here to shop.

We ultimately picked two versions of a movie called “Barsaat,” and he is so nice that he will courier it to our residence tonight as well as we have to fly back home to the states tomorrow. Support Hiresh so he can continue selling these posters and inspire film fanatics and art collectors.

We look forward to framing both of our new posters and hanging them in our home.
